leadText: Satomi Koorogi (Japanese: こおろぎさとみ Koorogi Satomi) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Satomi Koorogi (Japanese: こおろぎさとみ Koorogi Satomi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Koorogi was born as Satomi Kourogi (Japanese: 興梠さとみ Kourogi Satomi) on November 14, 1962, in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She voiced many people and Pokémon throughout . One of her most notable roles in that work was Misty's Togetic. Koorogi is currently affiliated with Production Baobab. She is bilingual, being capable of speaking both Japanese and English.
